No pictures, audio attachments, or replacement candidates are supplied, so assets, dialogue, onscreen_text and replacement_targets stay empty and the mode is t2va. The scope forbids added music and no speech or visible lettering is requested; only diegetic ambience (rain, engine hum) is shaped. shots.action: A locked-off view of the side window of a moving city bus at night. Rain streams down the glass in wavering threads and fattening beads, dragging the smeared reflections of streetlights and passing headlights into long wobbling streaks across the dark pane. Beyond the wet glass the street outside slides past as soft, out-of-focus pools of amber and pale blue light; inside the frame the window frame and a strip of worn bus interior trim hold steady. Droplets cling, swell and release, each one leaving a fresh wet track down the pane as the vehicle hums along.
subjects: the bus side window with rain running down the glass
muted reflections of streetlights and headlights smeared on the wet pane
out-of-focus night street lights beyond the window
the dark bus interior window frame and worn trim
sync_sound: steady rain pattering and ticking against the window glass
low continuous hum of the moving bus engine
faint wet hiss of tyres on the road outside
shots.what_changes: Rain gathers on the glass and begins to run, carrying blurred light reflections downward while the bus carries the window steadily along.

shots.action: The same locked camera holds on the bus window, now seen much closer, so the glass fills the frame. Individual water beads stand out sharp against the dark beyond: some tremble in place, some join and suddenly merge into heavier drops that break loose and cut crooked vertical channels through the film of water. Within each droplet the night street is bent into a tiny curved image of amber lamps and red tail lights, flipping and stretching as the drops slide. Behind the pane the deeper darkness of the bus interior is almost flat, and the wet glass breathes with a faint tremble from the road.
subjects: close-packed rain droplets on the bus window glass
tiny inverted reflections of street lamps and tail lights inside each drop
narrow trails of water running down the pane
the dim flat darkness of the bus interior behind the glass
sync_sound: close, delicate ticking of raindrops striking the glass
muffled low rumble of the bus engine
soft hiss of wet road passing beneath
shots.what_changes: Droplets merge and break loose, carving new channels down the glass as their mirrored street lights warp and slip sideways.

shots.action: The locked camera keeps the same bus window in view as the rain thickens and then eases. Sheets of water sheet across the pane in a quick gust, blurring the night outside into running bands of colour, before the flow thins to scattered slow trickles that hesitate and stop. The last few drops hang heavy and still on the glass, holding small steady points of amber light, with the dark street and its drifting reflections settled behind them. Nothing in the frame moves except the water on the window and the far-off lights sliding gently past.
subjects: the rain-streaked bus window glass with thinning water trails
a few heavy droplets holding pinpoints of amber light

the dark bus interior frame surrounding the pane

shots.what_changes: The downpour thickens into running sheets and then eases, leaving scattered slow trickles and a few still droplets on the glass.
